[SWS_CM_12007] New data samples received by CM at execution time of receive handler
⌈
In case new data samples arrive at Communication Management side during
the execution of a user defined receive handler, Communication Management shall
postpone the next call to receive handler until the previous call to receive handler is
finished.
⌋
